description:
We want to change the world. We’re a team of fast-executing social entrepreneurs on a mission to build the future of social change. You want to change the world? This is your chance! 
   
 We’re not looking for someone to do busy work or implement another Rails app. We are searching for an outstanding back end developer to build our business with! We want someone who sees iFLIP4 in its Beta stages, and who can envision a future where it is the place to go for EVERYONE who cares. We want someone who wants to create the future, not someone who will settle for an unfulfilling position at a giant corporation. 
   
 We don’t want a code monkey; we don’t want someone to say yes and implement every feature we ask for. What we want is a partner. Someone to bounce ideas off of, someone with a vision for the future of our company, and someone who has the desire and drive to make it a reality. 
   
 Importantly, the most driven, high performing interns will be given the opportunity to take on full time roles after we raise our Angel round of funding. 
   
 Responsibilities 
 Maintain and update the current Beta website on a regular basis 

 Support our current functional design, and help build code from scratch to support new, world-changing product features 

 Create modules for ExpressionEngine 

 Implement various API’s as needed 

 Author technical documentation with high level design documents 

 Work closely with our product and design teams to define feature specifications 

   
 Technical Requirements 
 Obtained or working towards MS/BE/BTech degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other technical field preferred 

 Strong coding and scripting ability on LAMP platform (PHP 5+, OOP PHP) 

 Solid GNU/Linux experience 

 Expert in ExpressionEngine (our CMS platform), and the ability to build add-ons & modules for ExpressionEngine 

 Solid database experience. MySQL preferred 

 Proven ability to work effectively across multiple teams 

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills 

 CodeIgniter knowledge a plus 

 Experience with Cloud Computing a plus 

 
 
 Obtained or working towards MS/BE/BTech degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or other technical field preferred

 Strong coding and scripting ability on LAMP platform (PHP 5+, OOP PHP)

 Solid GNU/Linux experience

 Expert in ExpressionEngine (our CMS platform), and the ability to build add-ons & modules for ExpressionEngine

 Solid database experience. MySQL preferred

 Proven ability to work effectively across multiple teams

 Excellent interpersonal and communication skills

 CodeIgniter knowledge a plus

 Experience with Cloud Computing a plus

 

 This position requires a commitment of about 20 hours/week. After we raise our Angel round of funding, this role can grow into a full-time position with a full salary and equity in iFLIP4, assuming the work you do is great! We are located in East Hanover, NJ, and telecommuting is fine with us.
